This specific interaction should trigger a massive spike in "Intimidated" (as his ego is bruised) and "Disbelief" (that his control is lost), while "Arrogant" should be near zero since he is no longer acting superior but rather threatened. Next time, I will score "Intimidated" as the dominant emotion (9-10), "Disbelief" as high (7-8), and "Arrogant" as very low (1-2), reflecting the shift from confident dismissal to defensive fear.
